production_operator_fd_diagnostic.interpretation: At the root19/Newton3 state, both nonzero correction perturbations are valid and preserve positive J, but the production matrix-free action disagrees strongly with centered residual differences. The second environment is a zero-direction control and its zero error is vacuous. The diagnostic and baseline native runs have byte-identical CSV, results, compiled pack and all exported mesh hashes, and both naturally reject; the diagnostic does not repair or change the path. The comparison does not identify the cause; projection, active-set behavior, and FP32 effects remain possible contributors.
